message: The other day, I realized it had been a while since I checked our go-bags. Instead of turning it into a chore, I called the kids over for a little family event. We pulled everything out and made a cozy afternoon of it—snacks, music, and a bit of planning for what we might need if we had to be on the move. It turned into a fun way to teach them about being ready without the stress. Plus, we ended up with a tidy bag and some sweet memories! What little rituals do you have for keeping your family prepared?
